name: Developer Code Review Assistant
description: An AI assistant that comments on pull requests with possible bugs, security issues and style problems. Developers decide whether to accept suggestions; the assistant cannot merge or deploy code.
documentation:
DATA: source code of internal repositories only; a secrets scanner blocks any file containing keys or credentials before it is sent.
VENDOR: enterprise tier of the AI coding service with a signed DPA; vendor does not retain or train on our code; SOC 2 report reviewed by security.
PERMISSIONS: read access to pull requests and comment permission only; cannot push, merge or trigger pipelines.
OVERSIGHT: all merges still require approval by a human reviewer under branch protection rules.
IP: legal reviewed licensing of generated suggestions.
MONITORING: monthly review of accepted vs rejected suggestions; security team audits comments on high-risk repositories.
LOGGING: every request logged with repository and user.
